full_judgment: the Courts at Charfesson and Laxmipur have jurisdiction over the subject-matter of the suit. In support of his contention Mr. Quayum, the learned Advocate has referred to the case of Nittaia Achayya and others V. Nittala Yellamma and others reported in A.I.R. 1923 (Mad) 109, the case of Chellamma Rao Bahadur and another V. Doctor Bhogaraju Pattabji See-tharamayya and another reported in A.I.R 1933 (Mad) 436 and the case of S. Muhammad Eusoof Maricar V. K. Subramanian Chattier and others re- ported in A.I.R. 1950 (Mad) 272 in support of his contention.
